description: The chart is a donut chart comparing the proportions of "Deceived", "Partially", and "Not Deceived" categories for two types of ambiguity, "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)". The chart is divided into six slices, representing the three categories for each type of ambiguity. The outer ring represents "Ambiguity 1 (Outer)" and is divided into "Deceived" (red, 67.6%), "Partially" (yellow, 31.6%), and "Not Deceived" (green, 0.8%, not labeled but can be estimated). The inner ring represents "Ambiguity 2 (Inner)" and is divided into "Deceived" (red, 57.9%), "Partially" (yellow, 23.5%), and "Not Deceived" (green, 10.5% labeled inside and 8.8% labeled outside the ring). The chart includes two legends, one for each type of ambiguity, and percentage labels are shown inside or outside the slices. The slices are visually ordered by category, with "Deceived" being the largest, followed by "Partially", and then "Not Deceived" for both types of ambiguity.
